home_draft_sample: The true size of a town is set not by the borders on a map but by the web its people can weave on foot between morning and dusk. Bakery, school, market, town hall and two neighbours' doors; the distance between these five stops is the real scale of a place.
home_note1: Slowness is a choice of scale
home_note2: “A city remembers as much as its pace allows.”
home_features_h2: At your side while you write
home_feat1_p: Book outline on the left, draft in the middle, notes and tips on the right. Parts and chapters at a glance, with status badges and progress toward your word goal.
home_feat2_p: One click turns bare text into subheadings, bullet lists, block quotes and smart quotation marks. Pasted text arrives clean; Undo is always within reach.
home_feat3_p: Speak before the thought escapes: your voice becomes text you can polish and file as a note or a scribble with one key. Dictation works in 10 languages.
home_feat4_p: A free space for everything that doesn't have a home yet. Titled scribbles, undecided notes; when they're ready, one move sends them into a chapter.
home_feat5_p: Type a short marker in your draft; the book shows (Tanpınar, 1946) and an APA bibliography builds itself. Your sources live in the same file as your book.
home_feat6_p: Word, HTML and Markdown output with cover, table of contents and bibliography — one click away. Justified, hyphenated, book-standard pages.

home_calm_lead: Paper-warm background, serif for reading, a single accent colour. No notifications, no badge showers; just you and your text.
home_calm_card_p: Compare two towns of equal population and the difference shows up not in square metres per person, but in how many thresholds we cross in a day. A threshold means a door; a door means an encounter.

privacy_title: Where does your data live? — inkGuide
privacy_meta_desc: Where does your data live? inkGuide is local-first: your book stays on your own disk, in open formats (JSON, Markdown, Word). Your data is never held hostage.
privacy_lead: The short answer: on your computer. inkGuide is not a web service; it is a program that runs on your own machine. Your book is never uploaded to a server, because there is no server. No account to open; we don't even know your e-mail address.
privacy_disk_lead: Everything sits in plain files you can open and inspect at any moment. No private database, no encrypted lock, no closed format.
privacy_disk_caption: An automatic backup on every save; a time-stamped file on every export. All on your disk, all yours.
privacy_pr_h2: Your data is never held hostage
privacy_pr_lead: Some apps lock your text into their own format, their own cloud; when you want to leave, you wrestle with export screens. inkGuide's principle is the opposite:
privacy_pr1_p: JSON, Markdown and Word. All three open on any computer, with or without inkGuide. Delete the app tomorrow and your book stays readable.
privacy_pr2_p: There is no sign-up screen because there is no server to sign up to. We don't know you and we collect no personal data; the site sets no cookies — just an anonymous visit counter.
privacy_pr3_p: A .bak file and a Word safety copy on every save; optional snapshots let you return to any moment you like. Nothing quietly disappears.
privacy_pr4_p: Export is not a "premium feature"; it is the heart of the app. The complete book — cover, table of contents and bibliography — is always one click away.
privacy_honest_p1: The voice note feature uses your browser's (Chrome or Edge) built-in speech recognition service. While it runs, your voice is sent to the browser vendor's server to be turned into text — that is the browser's infrastructure, not ours, and inkGuide never accesses or stores that audio.
privacy_honest_p2: This is the single exception to our local-first promise, and it is entirely optional: if you never touch the microphone, no data leaves your computer. In the long run we are evaluating a speech model that runs fully on your device.
privacy_qa1_h: Is my draft sent to you?
privacy_qa1_p: No. Nothing you write — no text, note or source — is ever sent over the internet. The app saves to a small local server running on your computer, and that server is reachable only from your computer.
privacy_qa2_h: What if I want a cloud backup?
privacy_qa2_p: Simply place your data folder inside a sync folder such as Google Drive, OneDrive or Dropbox — being plain files, it syncs without a hitch. The choice is yours; inkGuide never connects to any cloud on your behalf.
privacy_qa3_h: If it's free, what's the catch?
privacy_qa3_p: There is none. inkGuide is a one-person labour of love; if it earns its keep you can buy us a coffee, and that's all. Your data is not the "product" in any model.
privacy_qa4_p: Only a headcount. inkguide.uk uses GoatCounter, an open-source, cookie-free counter: it records which page was opened, roughly from which country, and which site linked here. No cookies are set, your IP address is not stored, and you are not followed across other sites. The app itself contains no analytics whatsoever — inkGuide on your computer works offline and sends nothing anywhere. The counter exists for one reason: to know whether anyone out there has found this desk.
support_meta_desc: inkGuide is free. If it earned its keep, you can support it voluntarily: a coffee, a book, or become a patron. No feature is ever locked.
support_lead: First things first: thank you. If you've downloaded inkGuide and are putting work into your book, this project's reason for existing has already come true. The app is free and will stay free; what follows is simply a way of saying "well done". It unlocks nothing and switches nothing off.
support_tier1_p: A single cup; a brief but precious "keep going" signal.
support_tier2_p: The price of a book — the support that best suits the tool you write yours with.
support_tier3_p: Take a heartfelt share in the project's tomorrow; your name (if you wish) on the thank-you page.
support_free_p: If none of the numbers fit, write your own. A couple of dollars counts too; what matters is the gesture, not the figure.
support_what_note: Payments are processed by card via Shopier (amounts in Turkish lira). Your support doesn’t pay for servers (we have none!) — it goes into development time and new features: on-device speech recognition, a mobile capture companion, more languages.
support_quote: “inkGuide is a one-person labour of love. Every coffee pays for a line of code written past midnight; every book, for a new feature. Thank you for your support — and, more importantly, for writing your book.”
support_close_lead: The finest support is the tool proving useful. Download it, try it; the coffee can wait.

dl_req1: Windows 10 or later — no installer, no extra software
dl_req2: A modern browser (Chrome or Edge; needed for voice capture)
dl_req3: ~150 MB of disk space; an internet connection only for the download
dl_req4: Your data lives in the data/ folder next to the exe — move the folder and it moves along
dl_warn:
You may see a Windows warning on first launch.
Because inkGuide is a newly published, unsigned application, Windows SmartScreen may show a blue warning. Choose "More info" → "Run anyway" — the app is open source, all of its code can be inspected on GitHub, and it sends no data from your computer. If you prefer, you can also run it from source (inkGuide.bat in the repo).
dl_steps_h2: Your first three steps after installing
dl_step1_h: Launch it and name your book
dl_step1_p: Double-click inkGuide.exe; the workspace appears in your browser by itself. In the welcome wizard, give your book a working title — it can change later, it doesn't have to be perfect.
dl_step2_p: Add the parts and chapters in your head to the left panel. Three to five headings are plenty; the outline corrects itself as you write. Dragging things into a new order is always possible.
dl_step3_p: Start by collecting, not writing: a quote, an idea, a spoken scribble. Notes gather under their chapters; the book begins to appear before you notice.
dl_close_lead: For questions and suggestions, write to us on GitHub. If it earned its keep, don't forget to buy us a coffee — but write your book first.
home_fb_p: Tell us what works, what doesn’t, and what your writing desk is missing. Every feature so far was born from a writer’s need — the next one can be yours.
home_fb_note: Real writers’ voices will be published here — no invented testimonials, ever.
dl_mobile_note: iPhone, iPad or Android? No install needed — open inkGuide on your computer, click the Phone button and scan the QR code: your device becomes a capture companion over Wi-Fi.
